name: Schools & education
title: School Bus Hire Melbourne | Excursions | Jia Tour
heading: School bus hire in Melbourne
description: Plan school excursion and education group transport with Jia Tour in Melbourne. Explore 7–57 seat options and request a quote for your school itinerary.
intro: Jia Tour provides bus and coach charter for school excursions, educational visits and school groups in Melbourne and Victoria. Share your timetable, passenger count and destination so we can discuss transport for your group.

sections.heading: Plan around your school day
sections.text: An excursion itinerary needs more than a destination. Include the time your group must arrive, the time you expect to leave and when students need to be back at school. If you have several visits in one day, list each stop in order. Tell us whether the vehicle is needed between venues or only for the outward and return journeys.

sections.heading: Count everyone travelling
sections.text: Include teachers, supervising adults and other accompanying passengers in your total. Jia Tour lists 7–14, 24, 34 and 57-seat options. The right choice also depends on bags, equipment, access needs and vehicle availability. If your group is larger than one listed vehicle, include the full group size in your enquiry so arrangements can be discussed.

sections.heading: Make pickup arrangements clear
sections.text: Provide the school name, street address, preferred entrance and a contact for the organiser. Mention known restrictions around gates, bus bays or the destination entrance. Ask the team about any documents your school needs before confirming the booking, and share any required arrival or collection procedure.

checklist: Required arrival, departure and return times

faqs.q: Should teachers be included in the passenger count?
faqs.a: Yes. Include every person travelling, including teachers, supervisors and other accompanying adults, when requesting your quote.

faqs.q: Can I enquire about more than one excursion stop?
faqs.a: Yes. List the venues in order with the time needed at each location. Jia Tour will review the proposed route and discuss availability and the transport arrangements.

faqs.q: Is the excursion booked when I send the form?
faqs.a: No. The form starts an enquiry. Confirm the vehicle, itinerary, price and booking arrangements directly with Jia Tour before treating transport as booked.

name: Corporate & events
title: Corporate & Event Bus Hire Melbourne | Jia Tour
heading: Corporate and event bus hire in Melbourne
description: Arrange Melbourne group transport for conferences, corporate functions and events. Share your venue, schedule and passenger numbers with Jia Tour for a quote.
intro: Jia Tour offers Melbourne bus and coach charter for conferences, business functions and corporate groups. Keep your transport plans in one place by sharing the event schedule, pickup locations and number of guests travelling.

sections.heading: Build the journey around your event
sections.text: Start with the time guests need to be at the venue, rather than just a preferred pickup time. Include registration, presentation or dinner start times, along with the planned finish. For events running across several days, send a separate outline for each day so the team can review the full transport requirement.

sections.heading: Organise hotels and collection points
sections.text: Let us know whether your group will leave from one office or hotel, or whether there are several proposed pickup points. Include street addresses and any venue instructions for coaches. If people will return to different locations, explain the expected groups and timing so the route can be considered before a quote is confirmed.

sections.heading: Choose for passengers and equipment
sections.text: The listed fleet options range from 7–14 seats to 24, 34 and 57 seats. Include luggage, presentation materials or event equipment in your enquiry, because seating capacity alone does not establish storage space. Tell us about access requirements and your event organiser’s contact details when discussing the journey.

checklist: Event date, venue and organiser contact

faqs.q: Can we request several pickup locations?
faqs.a: Include each proposed pickup address and the number of passengers at each stop. Jia Tour will discuss the route, timing and availability before confirming arrangements.

faqs.q: What if the event finish time is uncertain?
faqs.a: Tell the team your expected finish time and explain what may change. Agree on collection arrangements directly with Jia Tour before the booking is confirmed.

faqs.q: Can I request transport over several event days?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the dates, locations and daily timetable together so Jia Tour can review the complete request and discuss a quote.

name: Airport transfers
title: Melbourne Group Airport Transfers | Bus Hire | Jia Tour
heading: Group airport transfers in Melbourne
description: Request a Melbourne group airport transfer with Jia Tour. Share flight details, passenger numbers and luggage needs to discuss a suitable bus or coach.
intro: Jia Tour arranges group airport transfer enquiries for arrivals and departures in Melbourne. Tell us the airport, terminal, flight details and luggage requirements so we can discuss an appropriate vehicle and pickup plan.

sections.heading: For arriving groups
sections.text: Include the flight number, arrival date and scheduled arrival time, plus the airport and terminal. Explain whether the whole group arrives on one flight or separately. The landing time and the time passengers are ready for collection are different parts of the plan; agree on the meeting point and pickup arrangements with Jia Tour before travelling.

sections.heading: For departing groups
sections.text: Send the pickup address, flight departure details and the time your group needs to reach the terminal. Tell us about additional collection stops and any passengers joining along the way. Your enquiry should identify the organiser or travelling contact who can coordinate the group on the day.

sections.heading: Match luggage as well as seats
sections.text: Jia Tour lists 7–14, 24, 34 and 57-seat options. Include the number and approximate size of suitcases, along with oversized items such as sports equipment. A vehicle’s listed seats do not confirm that every luggage combination will fit. Ask the team to confirm capacity and access arrangements for your particular group.

checklist: Flight date and scheduled arrival or departure
Travelling contact and any access requirements

faqs.q: Does Jia Tour provide individual scheduled airport tickets?
faqs.a: This enquiry service is for group charter transport. Send the details of your own group to request a quote; the website does not sell individual scheduled shuttle tickets.

faqs.q: What should I tell you about luggage?
faqs.a: Include the quantity and approximate size of suitcases and any oversized items. Jia Tour needs these details to discuss vehicle suitability as well as passenger capacity.

faqs.q: What happens if our flight details change?
faqs.a: Contact Jia Tour with the updated flight information as soon as possible. Confirm any revised pickup time, meeting point and arrangements directly with the team.

name: Private groups & weddings
title: Wedding & Private Group Bus Hire Melbourne | Jia Tour
heading: Wedding and private group bus hire
description: Plan Melbourne wedding guest transport, family outings and private group travel with Jia Tour. Send your venues, guest numbers and timetable for a charter quote.
intro: Jia Tour provides bus and coach charter for wedding guests, family gatherings, celebrations and private groups from Melbourne. Share the day’s locations and timings to discuss a journey that brings your group together.

sections.heading: Connect the important parts of the day
sections.text: For a wedding, list the accommodation, ceremony and reception locations and explain which parts of the day require transport. Tell us when guests must arrive and when each event ends. If you would like different return times for separate groups, include those details in the initial enquiry so the proposed journeys can be reviewed together.

sections.heading: Plan for your actual guest list
sections.text: Count every passenger and identify who is travelling on each leg. A guest total for the whole event may differ from the number needing transport. The listed 7–14, 24, 34 and 57-seat options offer a starting point; luggage, access requirements and availability also affect which option can be arranged.

sections.heading: Make collection easy to understand
sections.text: Provide full venue addresses and any access or parking instructions supplied by the venue. Include a nominated organiser’s contact details so plans can be discussed in one place. The same information helps with birthday celebrations, family outings and club gatherings, whether the group needs a one-way journey or a return trip.

checklist: Date and celebration or outing type
Arrival times and proposed return journeys
Organiser contact, luggage and access needs

faqs.q: Can I enquire about different guest return times?
faqs.a: Yes. Include each proposed return time, destination and passenger count. Jia Tour will review the request and discuss what can be arranged.

faqs.q: Can you quote for a family or club outing?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose Private group & wedding on the enquiry form and describe the outing, date, group size and route. The team will discuss availability and a quote.

faqs.q: Are venue access arrangements included automatically?
faqs.a: Please share any access, parking or collection instructions from your venue. Confirm the final meeting points and transport arrangements with Jia Tour before travel.

name: Snow trips
title: Snow Trip Bus Hire from Melbourne | Jia Tour
heading: Snow trip bus hire from Melbourne
description: Plan group transport from Melbourne for a snow trip or alpine getaway. Discuss your resort, itinerary, passengers and equipment with Jia Tour for a charter quote.
intro: Jia Tour offers group charter transport for snowfield visits and alpine getaways from Melbourne. Share your destination and dates to discuss a suitable vehicle, travel arrangements and a quote.
imageAlt: Jia Tour 34-seat coach option; trip suitability is confirmed with the team

sections.heading: Start with the destination and timing
sections.text: Name the snowfield or resort, your preferred travel date and whether you want a day trip or a longer stay. Include your Melbourne pickup address, intended arrival time and planned departure from the mountain. Share any activities or accommodation that affect the timetable, so the transport request can be reviewed as a complete itinerary.

sections.heading: Allow for winter equipment
sections.text: Tell us how many people are travelling and whether the group will carry skis, snowboards, boots, bags or other bulky equipment. Jia Tour lists 7–14, 24, 34 and 57-seat options, but the available space and suitability for a particular alpine journey must be discussed separately. Please describe access requirements at the time of enquiry.

sections.heading: Confirm the details before booking activities
sections.text: Ask the team to clarify the proposed drop-off and collection points, what is included in the transport quote and how changes to the itinerary will be handled. Do not assume resort entry, lift passes, equipment hire or accommodation are included in a charter enquiry. Vehicle availability and final travel arrangements must be confirmed directly with Jia Tour.

checklist: Snowfield or resort and travel dates
Access needs and requested collection points

faqs.q: Are lift passes or equipment hire included?
faqs.a: A website enquiry requests transport. Do not assume lift passes, resort entry, equipment hire or accommodation are included; ask Jia Tour to specify the inclusions in your quote.

faqs.q: Can we bring skis and snowboards?
faqs.a: Include the quantities and sizes of winter equipment when you enquire. Jia Tour must confirm space and vehicle suitability for your proposed journey.

faqs.q: Can I enquire about an overnight snow trip?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the full dates, destination, accommodation location and proposed daily transport needs. The team will review the request and discuss availability.

name: Interstate trips
title: Interstate Bus & Coach Charter from Melbourne | Jia Tour
heading: Interstate bus and coach charter
description: Request interstate group transport from Melbourne with Jia Tour. Share your route, dates, overnight stops and passenger numbers for a tailored charter quote.
intro: Jia Tour offers bus and coach charter for interstate group journeys from Melbourne. Share your proposed route across Australia so the team can discuss the dates, stops, vehicle requirements and availability.

sections.heading: Send the whole route
sections.text: For an interstate journey, include the departure point, final destination and each planned stop in between. Explain whether the trip is one way or returns to Melbourne. Dates and locations for overnight stays help the team understand where the group and vehicle will need to be on each day.

sections.heading: Separate travel time from activities
sections.text: List any fixed appointments, attraction entry times or events, alongside the time you would like to spend at each stop. Tell us which parts of the schedule are flexible. Jia Tour can then discuss the proposed transport arrangements with you before the itinerary and booking are confirmed.

sections.heading: Plan for a longer journey
sections.text: Passenger numbers, luggage and equipment all matter when considering a vehicle for an extended trip. The listed fleet options are 7–14, 24, 34 and 57 seats. Describe access needs and any changes to the group during the journey. Ask for the quote inclusions to be explained, including any arrangements connected with overnight travel; do not assume accommodation, meals or attraction bookings are part of the charter.

checklist: Passenger count for each part of the trip

faqs.q: Can I request a one-way interstate charter?
faqs.a: Include the departure point, final destination and one-way requirement in your enquiry. Jia Tour will review the route and dates and discuss availability and a quote.

faqs.q: What details are needed for a multi-day trip?
faqs.a: Send the daily route, overnight locations, travel dates, passenger count and any fixed event times. Include luggage and access requirements so the full request can be considered.

faqs.q: Does the quote include hotels and attractions?
faqs.a: This website requests charter transport. Ask Jia Tour to specify all inclusions and exclusions; do not assume hotels, meals or attraction bookings are included.

name: Tours & day trips
title: Day Trip & Tour Bus Hire Melbourne | Jia Tour
heading: Day trip and tour bus hire from Melbourne
description: Plan private group transport for sightseeing, wine region visits and day trips from Melbourne. Share your itinerary with Jia Tour and request a bus charter quote.
intro: Jia Tour provides charter transport for private group day trips, sightseeing and wine region visits from Melbourne. Bring your proposed itinerary and group details so we can discuss transport for your day out.

sections.heading: Give each stop enough detail
sections.text: List your proposed destinations in order, together with any attraction entry, restaurant booking or activity start times. Include how long you plan to stay at each stop and the time you would like to return. If the itinerary is still taking shape, identify the confirmed parts and the ideas you would like to discuss.

sections.heading: Keep transport and activity bookings clear
sections.text: A charter enquiry is a request for group transport. Ask Jia Tour to explain the quote inclusions and confirm whether any other arrangements have been agreed. Attraction tickets, tastings, meals and guided activities should not be assumed to be included. Sharing your existing bookings helps the team understand the timing requirements.

sections.heading: Choose a vehicle for the whole day
sections.text: Jia Tour lists 7–14, 24, 34 and 57-seat options. Share the total passenger count, pickup addresses, luggage or equipment and any access needs. Let us know if people will join or leave during the day. Vehicle suitability and availability are confirmed with the team as part of discussing your journey.

checklist: Pickup addresses and preferred return time

faqs.q: Can we suggest our own day-trip itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes. Share your proposed destinations, timings and passenger numbers. Jia Tour will review the transport request and discuss availability and a quote.

faqs.q: Are attraction tickets or tastings included?
faqs.a: Do not assume they are included in charter transport. Confirm the quote inclusions directly with Jia Tour and identify any activity bookings you have already made.

faqs.q: Can I enquire before the itinerary is final?
faqs.a: Yes. Include the details you know and explain which dates, stops or timings are still flexible. The team can discuss the next information needed for your quote.

name: Travel agencies & groups
title: Travel Agency & Inbound Group Transport | Jia Tour
heading: Charter transport for travel agencies and groups
description: Discuss Melbourne and touring group transport with Jia Tour. Send your agency itinerary, flight details, passenger numbers and vehicle requirements for a quote.
intro: Jia Tour supports travel agencies planning group transport in Melbourne, Victoria and across state borders. Send your itinerary so the team can discuss the route, schedule and vehicle requirements together.

sections.heading: Bring the itinerary into one brief
sections.text: Include airport movements, hotel addresses, daily visits and any interstate travel in the same request. Mark the travel dates and required arrival times for each leg. If arrangements are provisional, identify what is confirmed and what may change, rather than assuming a tentative itinerary reserves a vehicle.

sections.heading: Describe the travelling group
sections.text: Include passengers, tour leaders and guides in the total. Provide luggage quantities, equipment and access requirements, along with any change in group size between legs. Jia Tour lists 7–14, 24, 34 and 57-seat options; the team will discuss suitability and availability for the itinerary you submit.

sections.heading: Agree on contacts and responsibilities
sections.text: Nominate an agency contact for the quote and an on-trip contact for the group. Share relevant collection instructions from hotels, airports and venues. Ask Jia Tour to set out the transport inclusions, exclusions and confirmation requirements. Guiding, accommodation, attraction tickets and other travel arrangements should be clarified separately rather than assumed to form part of a charter enquiry.

checklist: Dated itinerary with each transport leg
Passenger total including guides and leaders
Luggage, access needs and travelling contact

faqs.q: Should guides and tour leaders be counted as passengers?
faqs.a: Yes. Include everyone who needs a seat, including guides and tour leaders, and explain any passenger changes between transport legs.

faqs.q: Can one enquiry cover airport transfers and touring?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the complete itinerary with the dates, locations and passenger numbers for each leg so Jia Tour can review the combined transport request.

faqs.q: Does an enquiry reserve the requested vehicle?
faqs.a: No. Availability, vehicle choice, pricing and booking arrangements must be confirmed directly with Jia Tour. An automatic acknowledgement only confirms receipt of the enquiry.
